name: Crayon Friends!
source:
Classroom 13 is excited to make fun Halloween crafts out of the materials you provide them with, like crayons, clay, scissors, staplers, and f̷l̵e̸s̷h̵ !

[From [url=https://nowshake.itch.io/crayonfriends]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
13號教室的孩子們正興奮地準備製作有趣的萬聖節手工藝品，材料由你提供：蠟筆、黏土、剪刀、釘書機，還有血肉！

[來源：[url=https://nowshake.itch.io/crayonfriends]Itch.io[/url]]
